name: packages
description_en: Community maintained packages for OpenWrt. Documentation for submitting pull requests is in CONTRIBUTING.md
readme_excerpt: OpenWrt packages feed Description This is the OpenWrt "packages"-feed containing community-maintained build scripts, options and patches for applications, modules and libraries used within OpenWrt. Installation of pre-built packages is handled directly by the opkg utility within your running OpenWrt system or by using the OpenWrt SDK on a build system.
